summary_1line: Sita gives Hanuman her jewel and recounts a private memory of Rama to prove her identity, urging him to hasten Rama to rescue her.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita, pale and tearful in the Ashoka grove, removes a radiant pearl jewel from her robe and places it in Hanuman’s hands.
Rama plucks a blade of kusa grass and transforms it into a blazing Brahma-weapon that streaks through the sky pursuing a terrified crow.
The exhausted crow falls at Rama’s feet while the fiery missile hovers behind it, and Rama spares it by taking only its right eye.
